status_definitions.complete: The subject has a canonical home and sufficient foundational treatment.
status_definitions.substantially_complete: The reusable foundation and structured records exist; explicit edge cases remain recorded for later evidence.
status_definitions.distributed: Distinct books own different mechanical, tactical, strategic, or procedural layers.
status_definitions.underdeveloped: The subject exists but lacks a major practical or reference layer.
status_definitions.structured_data_gap: Methods exist in prose, but exhaustive versioned object records do not.
status_definitions.planned_dossier_work: The general method exists; nation-specific applications remain to be written.
status_definitions.verification_pending: The question exists in the research register but lacks reliable resolution.
status_definitions.intentionally_excluded: The official source is the better home unless a concrete project creates a need.
